name: get_processes
title: Get process snapshot
description: Read-only process snapshot for long-running tasks (installers, builds, simulators). Filter by name substring or pid. Returns pid/name/session_id/elevated/started_at/uptime, and optionally the process's top-level windows. Use wait_for(condition.type=process) to block until a process exits instead of polling from the host shell. Exposes process names for the whole session; run in a trusted environment.

name.description: Process name substring, with or without .exe.

include_windows.description: Default false. Include window_count and the largest window (hwnd/title/class). Enabling it costs one window enumeration per call.
